title: Why Choose Valencia Smile: What to Expect at Your First Visit
seoTitle: Your First Dental Visit at Valencia Smile: What to Expect
seoDescription: Know what happens at your first visit: exam, digital X-rays, cleaning, a written plan and comfort options. Book your first appointment in Valencia.
excerpt: What happens at a first visit to Valencia Smile: how to prepare, the step-by-step exam, cleaning, treatment planning, comfort options and insurance.
keyTakeaways: Plan 60 to 90 minutes for a first visit that includes an exam, imaging and a cleaning when needed.
Bring ID, your insurance card, a list of medications and allergies, and your top two or three concerns.
The exam covers history review, a visual check, digital X-rays as needed, intraoral photos, gum screening, bite and oral cancer checks.
You leave with findings explained in plain language, written estimates, and phased options to prioritize care.
The practice verifies insurance, files claims on your behalf, and offers third-party financing subject to approval.
